name: Fused Lorenzo Predictor + Quantizer
description: Fused Lorenzo predictor + error-bounded quantizer (TInput = f32/f64, TCode = u8/u16/u32). 1D/2D/3D. Lossy. Supports ABS, NOA, and REL error-bound modes. Three forward outputs: codes, outlier_errors, outlier_indices. Optional 1-D tile centering follows the FSZ design and adds a means output.

config.name: errorBound
config.description: Error bound value. Interpretation depends on errorMode.

config.name: errorMode
config.description: ABS = absolute |x-x'|<=eb; NOA = value-range relative eb*(max-min); REL = pseudo-REL (global-approximate point-wise relative) eb*max(|x|). NB: this REL is pseudo-REL, not PFPL's true point-wise REL.

config.name: quantRadius
config.description: Quantization radius. Default 2^15 for u16 TCode.

config.name: outlierCapacity
config.description: Fraction of input size reserved for outlier storage.

config.name: zigzagCodes
config.description: Zigzag-encode codes before storage to improve compressibility when codes cluster near zero.

config.name: centering
config.description: Enable FSZ-style per-tile mean centering in 1-D; adds a means output port. Independently implemented from the paper.

paper.title: cuSZ: An Error-Bounded Lossy Compressor for GPU Scientific Data
